CustomField.label: Sharing Hygiene Notes
CustomField.description: Deliberately separate from RAA_Warnings__c: these are informational findings about the sharing configuration itself (for example, a sharing rule whose target group has no members among the scanned users), not signs that the scan was incomplete or something went wrong. Kept apart so the UI never conflates the two.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Informational notes about the sharing configuration found during this scan (not scan warnings/errors).
